definitions.explanation: The direction or side opposite to right.

examples.japanese: {左|ひだり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がって→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{左|ひだり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}→郵便局：00579_yuubinkyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えます→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: You can see the post office on the left.

examples.japanese: ⟦{左手|ひだりて}→左手：10975_hidarite⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}きます→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I write with my left hand.
There is a big tree on the left side of the road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}たら→出る：00513_deru⟧{左|ひだり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。⟦{三分|さんぷん}→分：00928_fun⟧⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{着|つ}きます→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: When you leave the station, walk to the left. You'll arrive in about three minutes.

notes:
{左|ひだり} indicates the left direction, opposite of ⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {左|ひだり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧: to turn left
- {左|ひだり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look left
- {左|ひだり}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧: from left to right

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{左手|ひだりて}→左手：10975_hidarite⟧: left hand
- ⟦{左足|ひだりあし}→左足：27500_hidariashi⟧: left foot/leg
- ⟦{左側|ひだりがわ}→左側：22836_hidarigawa⟧: left side
- ⟦{左折|させつ}→左折：09218_sasetsu⟧: left turn (traffic term)
- ⟦{左利|ひだりき}き→左利き：22396_hidarikiki⟧: left-handed

TRAFFIC NOTE:
In Japan, traffic drives on the left side of the road.

POLITICAL USAGE:
{左|ひだり}/⟦{左翼|さよく}→左翼：22746_sayoku⟧ can mean "left-wing" in political contexts.
